verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMUTAMBUZE nze
Era-omugenyi;
Eby'omu nsi bingi
Bijja-okunnimba.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu atwal(a) abato
Alibakulembera;
N'abatuusa ewuwe,
Mu maka ge ye.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ensi eyo nnungi,
Temuli kabi,
N'ennaku temuli,
Tebituukayo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Yesu atwal(a) abato
Alibakulembera;
N'abatuusa ewuwe,
Mu maka ge ye.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Olugendo olwo
Alutambula
Asaba-eri Yesu
Obutalemwa.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Yesu atwal(a) abato
Alibakulembera;
N'abatuusa ewuwe,
Mu maka ge ye.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Yesu onnongoose,
Onjigirize;
Onnumggamye,nkwate,
Erijja gy'oli.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Yesu atwal(a) abato
Alibakulembera;
N'abatuusa ewuwe,
Mu maka ge ye.
